title: Melon Granita
blurb: A light, icy dessert made from blended melon and lemon juice, frozen and scraped into delicate crystals.
steps: Cut the melon in half, scoop out the seeds, then cut away the skin and chop the flesh roughly.
Put the melon, water, sugar and lemon juice into a blender and blend until completely smooth.
Taste and add more sugar or lemon juice if needed, then pour the mixture into a shallow freezer-proof container.
Freeze for about 2 hours until the edges start to set, then use a fork to scrape and break up the ice crystals.
Return to the freezer and repeat the scraping process every 30 minutes for 2 to 3 hours until you have a container full of light, fluffy ice crystals.
Serve scooped into chilled glasses or bowls.
